input.subject: Export completed but email never arrives
input.description: The CSV export job completed successfully, but the email containing the download link has not arrived.

matches.subject: CSV export missing last week of data
matches.resolution_notes: The export job's date range used the same UTC/local timezone gap as the sync issue in T-1104. Applied the same buffer fix to the export query.

matches.subject: Export button greyed out for read-only users
matches.resolution_notes: This was expected behavior per the permission model, but the customer wasn't aware exports required editor-level access. Clarified the permission model and upgraded the specific user's role at the admin's request.

matches.subject: Exported numbers don't match dashboard totals
matches.resolution_notes: The export used a slightly different filter default (including cancelled orders) than the dashboard view. Aligned both to exclude cancelled orders by default and documented the distinction.

input.subject: Export arrives but recent transactions are absent
input.description: The CSV export was delivered, but the most recent seven days of transactions are absent from the file.

matches.subject: PDF report export times out for large date ranges
matches.resolution_notes: PDF rendering was done synchronously in the request thread. Moved large exports to an async job with an email notification when the file is ready.
